title: Field Trip Registration Form
subtitle: An original operational registration for field trip that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Field Trip Registration Form supports the complete field trip workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Field Trip Registration Form when the assigned trip lead needs one fillable record for trip participant, itinerary, transport, supervision, and return without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Field trip registration identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this registration to one trip participant, itinerary, transport, supervision, and return record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Field trip record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Field trip scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Field trip registration intake and requested placement
sections.guidance: Capture one requested program assignment, schedule, and accountable enrollment route.

blocks.label: Field trip registration information
items: Trip group, grade, or program assignment
Departure and expected return window
Transportation and seat or mobility support need
Destination activity and participation limitations
Guardian and alternate contact routing
Authorized pickup or return-to-school arrangement
Allergy, medication, meal, or health-plan reference location
Accessibility, language, sensory, or behavioral support route

blocks.label: Schedule, arrival, departure, routing, and owner
Registration goal, source, participant needs, and requested outcome

fields.label: Goal, source, participant needs, and requested outcome

blocks.label: Registration boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records a field-trip workflow; it does not replace guardian permission, qualified medical direction, transportation rules, emergency services, or local supervision requirements. Stop movement or release when identity, headcount, authorization, health support, or safety cannot be confirmed. Share only minimum necessary information and route decisions to the authorized reviewer.

sections.title: Field trip contacts, release route, and support readiness
sections.guidance: Route sensitive health and support information to its approved record and reviewer.

blocks.label: Registration readiness and stop conditions
items: Permission or roster status is missing or inconsistent
Student is present but not assigned to the trip group
Destination, activity, route, or vehicle changed
Departure, transfer, or return headcount does not reconcile
Required support, medication custodian, or accessible transport is unavailable
Guardian or authorized release arrangement cannot be confirmed
Student is separated, missing, ill, injured, or in immediate distress
Weather, site, transport, or emergency authority issues a stop or change

blocks.label: Support or record source, applicability, owner, and status
Minimum-necessary information, access limits, assumptions, and open questions

fields.label: Information boundary, access limits, assumptions, and open questions

sections.title: Field trip placement, readiness, and authorization decision
sections.guidance: Separate requested placement from authorized placement and retained conditions.

blocks.label: Field trip readiness evidence
items: Trip roster matches the assigned group and destination
Departure, transfer, and return headcount points are defined
Guardian permission status is linked without bundling unrelated consent
Transportation provider, vehicle, or walking route reference is recorded
Chaperone assignment and locally required coverage are confirmed
Accessibility and participation support route is confirmed
Meal, allergy, medication, and health-plan references are routed privately
Destination contact and emergency meeting point are available
Alternate transport or delayed-return communication route is recorded
Authorized release arrangement is known before departure

blocks.label: Requested element, review result, condition, owner, and evidence
Field trip registration decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the program administrator, guardian, and qualified health or emergency reviewer.

blocks.label: Placement rationale, alternatives, limits, and participant or guardian communication

sections.title: Field trip onboarding, exceptions, and first-day handoff
sections.guidance: Turn each unresolved condition into an owned action before participation begins.

blocks.label: Registration exception indicators
items: Trip cannot start under the documented plan
Student participation status needs guardian or administrator review
Transport, destination, or supervision arrangement changed
Health, allergy, medication, or support plan cannot be followed
Emergency, missing-student, or immediate safety response is active
Return, authorized release, or final headcount remains unresolved

blocks.label: Condition, required action, owner, due point, and acceptance
Onboarding and first-day handoff
items: Authorized assignment and schedule communicated
Arrival, attendance, and departure routes visible
Guardian and emergency communication routes available
Approved health and support records routed privately
Open condition has an owner and due point
First review date and completion evidence identified

sections.title: Field trip outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Field trip closeout controls
items: Final headcount and roster status accepted
Guardian or school return communication recorded
Unresolved incident or support need has an owner
Equipment and private records returned to approved custody
Transport or destination follow-up reference linked
Trip record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Registration closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
